description: The time-trial ghost look (JetSkiModel.ghost) on a hull scene: test/craft/hull_preview.tscn shows the code-built hull, the generated hull and the generated hull as a ghost. The ghost's hull scene meshes are drawn see-through by hull_paint_ghost.gdshader, after the water (render priority 1) and without shadows, still in the rider's colours; the other generated hull is drawn by hull_paint.gdshader with shadows. A model that gets a new colour in the frame it enters the tree is rebuilt without engine errors.

steps.name: the generated hull is painted and casts shadows
the ghost's hull and handlebar are see-through and drawn after the water
no part of the ghost casts a shadow
the ghost keeps the rider's colours
the ghost's rider sits at the seat it was given

steps.eval: [set_meta('late', ResourceLoader.load('res://jetski/model/jetski_model.tscn').instantiate()), get_meta('late').set('hull_scene', ResourceLoader.load('res://craft/hulls/generated_hull.tscn')), get_meta('late').set('position', Vector3(0, 0, 8)), add_child(get_meta('late')), get_meta('late').set('hull_color', Color(0.2, 0.7, 0.4))]
steps.name: a model with a hull scene gets a new colour in the frame it enters the tree, as on the craft select screen, so it is rebuilt before it is drawn
the rebuilt hull has the new colour, and freeing the first hull raised no engine errors
